text:
olga (devex): Pushed a compact docs PR covering structured output + tool calling edgecases. Includes migration tips, tiny JS/Python snippets, and a short jsonschema guardrail. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/610

ben (eng): Skimming — important to call out that runtime uses `tool_call` and older examples might still reference `tool`. We should give a safe repo replace example and recommend tests.

olga (devex): Agreed. I added a safer perl backup one-liner and a `git grep | xargs sed -n` suggestion rather than destructive sed by default.

tara (docs): Also added a one-sentence guardrail: "If your tool requires structured args, place them in `arguments` as a JSON string and validate with a schema before invoking." Kept it terse.

ben (eng): Can we show a tiny fallback pattern for callers? i.e., prefer JSON.parse/json.loads but if that fails, return a helpful error rather than silently calling tools.

olga (devex): Done — JS and Python snippets show try/catch + fallback to {_raw: ...}. Also added a unit-test suggestion: assert parser handles both `{\"tool_call\":{\"name\":\"x\",\"arguments\":\"{\\\"k\\\":1}\"}}` and a free-text reply.

ci-bot: label added: area:structured-output, needs-review · preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/610

ben (eng): tiny wording nit: don't imply SDK auto-parses. Keep examples explicit.

olga (devex): Updated wording to "callers must parse and validate" and linked migration guide under /docs/migration. Merging after CI. Thanks!"
